instagram.author: thesocialsandwich
instagram.body:
A free tool to make your Instagram better?! No it’s not me, it’s… 

Edits! A free video editing app by Instagram. It’s honestly a game changer 🙌

Also this isn’t paid but Insta I know you’re watching, it can be 😉
This one tool honestly saves me so much time every week and it makes my videos so much better than what they used to be. And no, no, the tool is not me. The tool is it's Edits. Edits. Edits is amazing. It's a game changer. I am shocked at how many people aren't using Edits yet. It's such a good tool to make videos. I'm making this video, this green screen, within Edits right now. It's super easy to edit, add text, add subtitles, which I'll have on the bottom. It also saves every video into a library, so you can go back and re-hash and reuse old content, which is just lovely. And then finally, they've just updated the stats, so you can actually look at what your videos are doing, how they're performing, how many likes, how many views they're getting. It ranks them from your most views to your least views. So, you can actually go through and you can see what reels are making the difference, what is actually working for me, which is super important. I don't think enough people look at the numbers and within Edits, it makes it super easy. So, give Edits a go. Let me know how you go.
